events.label: The reporter's test finds the weakness
The reporter emails Apple, Chrome, Microsoft, Mozilla and eMudhra
Mozilla confirms the proof of key control
eMudhra acknowledges and disables the affected DV issuer
Chrome blocks them with a CRLSet
eMudhra revokes all eight as ca_compromise
Bug comment: several people recovered the keys, some publicly
Bug comment: about 30,000 certificates to migrate
Cloudflare CDN and Zero Trust mitigations
Debian DSA-6572-1 removes the emSign ECC G3 and Comodo AAA roots
Tracker baseline: 20 of 24 patched; Composer lists versions but is flagged pending
Frozen trust stores keep accepting them until July 2039
